subject: Private deployment pricing: entitlement, platform fee & support options
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finserv.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@finserv.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Private deployment pricing — request for detailed breakdown

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the demo last week — the on-prem/VPC option looks promising. Procurement and engineering have a couple of asks before we can move to commercial review:

1) We need a clear line-item breakdown for a private deployment (on-prem/VPC) including: perpetual license or term license options, per-instance entitlement pricing, one-time setup fees, ongoing platform fee (monthly/annual) and recommended support tiers (and what each tier includes).

2) FinServ is looking at a 3-year commitment if the economics work. Please confirm what discount bands are available for 2-year and 3-year commitments (both for license and platform fees).

3) Security/compliance: we'll need SOC 2 report and confirmation of KMS/HSM options for key custody — we flagged this for our security review.

4) Can you confirm whether the platform fee can be credited/waived in year 1 as part of an enterprise commitment?

I've attached the RFP excerpt for context. Can we get a written proposal with the breakdown by EOD Wednesday?

Regards,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Procurement
FinServ Analytics

Attachments: RFP_FinServ_2025.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finserv.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 11:08:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing — request for detailed breakdown

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear ask and the RFP. Looping in Avery (pricing lead) and Dev (solutions engineering) so we can get a clean line-item proposal and confirm the KMS/HSM details.

Quick answers up front:
- We can do term licensing (1/2/3 year) and enterprise multi-year commits — pricing bands vary by commit length and capacity.
- Platform fee is configurable; we frequently offer partial or full year credits on multi-year deals, but it depends on total ARR commit.
- SOC 2 evidence is available; Dev will confirm HSM/KMS setup and on-prem encryption architecture.

Avery — can you draft a 2/3-year price table and include an option where year 1 platform fee is credited for a 3-year commit? Dev — please call out any constraints on HSM integrations and on-prem deployment packaging.

I can also schedule a 30-min call Wed morning if that helps speed sign-off.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Sales, EMEA
Redwood Inference
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finserv.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 08:35:00 +0000
Subject: Redwood private deployment — initial price proposal (draft)

Hi all — per Hannah's request, attached is a draft pricing worksheet and a short summary. Key points below (draft numbers, subject to final legal T&Cs):

Summary pricing (list price before discount):
- Term license (per instance): €120k / year (1-year term)
- Multi-year license: 2-year = €216k (10% off list), 3-year = €288k (20% off list)
- One-time onboarding/setup fee: €35k (covers deployment support and validation)
- Platform fee (managed control plane/console + telemetry): €30k / year
- Support tiers (annual): Standard: included (business-hours email + 24h response for Sev 1); Premium: €25k (24/7 + 4h Sev1 response + quarterly reviews); Enterprise: €55k (named TAM, 1h Sev1, on-site review option)

Discount guidance we can offer now:
- 2-year commit: up to 15% off license list price (tiered by ARR)
- 3-year commit: up to 22% off license list price; platform fee credit negotiable (we can credit up to 100% of year 1 platform fee for a 3-year commit at ARR thresholds)
- Additional commercial credit: if customer transitions to Redwood Dedicated within 12 months we can add a one-time 10% rebate on license net renewal

Security/ops notes (from Dev):
- SOC 2 Type II report available (redacted) — will provide link.
- KMS/HSM: we support customer-managed KMS in our VPC deployment. For on-prem HSM integrations, we can support PKCS#11-compatible HSMs; we recommend a short POC window to validate hardware compatibility.

Attachments: Redwood_Private_Pricing_Proposal_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Next steps: Liam — if these bands look reasonable I propose we produce an amendment for a 3-year commit (22% off + year 1 platform fee credit) and send to your procurement for review. Happy to take a quick call Wednesday morning to walk the numbers.

Thanks,
Avery
Avery Johnson
Senior Sales Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finserv.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@finserv.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Nov 2025 09:46:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Redwood private deployment — initial price proposal (draft)

Avery, Hannah — thanks for the fast turnaround and the clear breakdown. A few counterpoints from Procurement & Security:

1) Discount: FinServ needs at least 25% off license list price for a 3-year commit to get internal approval. 22% is close but short of the internal threshold.
2) Platform fee: would prefer the platform fee to be capped (€15k) and not just a single-year credit — we need predictable ongoing OpEx in our model.
3) Support: the Enterprise tier looks close, but we need guaranteed SOC 2 evidence and a written escalation path with named SLAs for Sev1/Sev2 incidents.
4) KMS/HSM: we'll need written confirmation of supported HSMs and any integration/engineering time estimates in the SOW.

Can you update the amendment to reflect: 25% net on license for 3 years OR a blended outcome where you keep 22% but cap platform fee at €15k/year (with no increase in year 2/3)? Also include the SOC 2 link and HSM compatibility addendum.

If we can get a final amendment by EOD today, procurement will route for signature tomorrow.

Regards,
Liam
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finserv.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Nov 2025 15:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Redwood private deployment — initial price proposal (draft)

Hi Liam — appreciate the specifics; we wanted to move quickly so we prepared an amendment. Two commercial options we're willing to commit to today (finals subject to legal review & standard T&Cs):

Option A (preferred):
- 3-year term, 25% off license list price, platform fee capped at €15k/year.
- One-time onboarding fee €35k (unchanged).
- Enterprise support tier included for the first year; thereafter customer may elect to continue Enterprise or downgrade to Premium at renewal pricing.
- SOC 2 Type II (redacted) link included; HSM compatibility addendum attached.

Option B (alternate):
- 3-year term, 22% off license list price + year 1 platform fee fully credited.
- Same support and onboarding terms as above.

We will proceed with Option A if you confirm — it's the most straightforward for both sides and meets your procurement threshold. I've uploaded a short amendment that implements Option A and includes a DocuSign wrapper for signature. If you prefer Option B, confirm and we'll push that instead.

Attachments: Pricing_Amendment_3yr_discount.pdf (application/pdf)
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/1234-Redwood-Amendment

If you confirm, Avery and I will get Legal to generate the final SOW and invoice.

Thanks,
Hannah
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finserv.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@finserv.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Nov 2025 18:07:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Redwood private deployment — initial price proposal (draft)

Hannah — thanks, Option A is acceptable. We'll route the amendment to our legal and sign once we have the final SOW. Please send the SOC 2 redacted report and the HSM addendum link to our security mailbox (procurement-security@finserv.com). Also send invoice instructions and the procurement contact for Redwood finance so we can prepare the PO.

I'll mark this as green on our side pending DocuSign signature.

Best,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Procurement
FinServ Analytics
